snippet.title: Rock of the Dead Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A new gameplay trailer for Rock of the Dead! 

ROCK OUT WITH YOUR GUITAR OUT!

Grab your axe and jump off stage as you transcend from aspiring musician to global rock god! Use the power of rock to unleash sonic blasts on hordes of flesh eaters! Riff your way through the infected masses to the soul-ripping tunes of Rob Zombie and save the world!
